_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Security Plan
summary: The Security Plan defines security processes and procedures used by the government to identify and monitor a contractor's security methods and activities at the Combined Tactical Training Ranges during a contract.
use_relationship:
The Security Plan defines security processes and procedures. The Security Plan is used by the government to identify and monitor a contractor's security methods and activities at the Combined Tactical Training Ranges (CTTR) during the performance of a contract.

This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

Reference documents cited in this DID shall be provided as Government Furnished Information (GFI) in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Security Plan shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Security Plan shall include references to the applicable Statement of Work (SOW) section and supporting tier documentation for all areas. It shall also contain the following sections:

children.title: Section 1. Organization and Security Methods.
children.content: This section shall include the following:

children.title: Organizational Chart identifying roles and responsibilities of the security workforce in the areas of physical security, personnel security, information security, communication security (COMSEC), Cybersecurity, and Information Assurance (IA).
Procedures for maintaining Classified Material Inventory information at the CTTR in the Information Management System (IMS).
children.content: The information shall contain the following:

children.title: Date of the material
Date of receipt of dispatch
Classification
Unclassified description of the material
The activity from which the material was received or to which the material was dispatched.
Location
A description of the control entry and access to the facility and range locations listed in Annex 3 (Government Furnished Facilities and Support Requirements)
Security Entry
Control Badges
Range/Facility Access Control
Procedures for posting and maintaining security signs at the access point(s) to each security-restricted area.

Procedures for safeguarding Automated Information Systems (AIS) data in accordance with (IAW) DoD 5220.22-M Chapter 8; MCAS Yuma Station Order 5510.30 (Standard Operating Procedures for Marine Corps Air Station Yuma Information Security Program), and NSWC 5239 series (Information Systems Security Program).
Identify Communication Security (COMSEC) services, transfer and movement of equipment and responsibilities.
Identify courier services, responsibilities and processes.
Section 2. Classified Material Emergency Action Plan.
children.content: This section shall include the following:

children.title: Procedures for safeguarding classified material in emergency situations.
children.content: The procedures shall be as simple and practical as possible and shall be adaptable to any type of emergency.

children.title: Procedures for promptly reporting to the CSA, any emergency situation which renders the facility incapable of safeguarding classified material.
Section 3.
children.content: This section shall include a Disaster Recovery Plan to restore systems identified by the government to operational status. It shall include Information Assurance (IA) approval process procedures for changes outside current approved System Security Authorization Agreement (SSAA) configuration.
